about.heroDesc: Kariv Glamour is an independent watch marketplace and reseller based in Prague. Listings are offered by private owners, independent businesses and Kariv. We have no affiliation, endorsement or authorised-dealer relationship with the watch manufacturers shown on this website.
about.storyP1: Kariv Glamour was born from a simple observation: buying a luxury watch should be straightforward and transparent. Buyers need clear information about condition, origin, seller and any authentication performed on a specific watch.
about.storyP2: Our platform brings together new, pre-owned, vintage and collector watches. We review submitted listing information and require sellers to disclose known replacement or non-original parts; a listing review is not a physical authentication of the watch.
about.storyP3: Based in Prague, Czech Republic, Kariv Glamour brings watch discovery and product information together in one online marketplace.
about.v1Desc: We prohibit counterfeit watches, review listing information and ask sellers to describe condition, parts and accompanying documents accurately.
about.v2Desc: Detailed condition assessments, comprehensive photography, and honest descriptions ensure you know exactly what you're acquiring.
about.v3Desc: Check who is selling a watch and the terms that apply to the purchase. An approved dealer account does not certify each watch or indicate manufacturer authorisation.
about.v4Desc: Our dedicated team of watch specialists provides personalized guidance throughout your acquisition journey.
about.v5Desc: Free insured shipping is available across the EU. Check the delivery estimate and shipping information for your order.
about.v6Desc: Founded by collectors for collectors, our passion for fine watchmaking drives every decision we make.

authentication.heroDesc: 24kariv.com is operated by Kariv Glamour s.r.o. We offer watches from our own inventory and independent sellers. Genuine watches are a requirement for every listing; approval of a listing is not a certificate that Kariv has physically authenticated the watch.
authentication.sellerChecksTitle: How we screen sellers and ownership
authentication.s1Desc: Every seller must own the watch offered, describe it accurately and be able to support claims about its origin and condition. Counterfeit watches and components bearing counterfeit trademarks are not permitted, whether sold by Kariv or a third-party seller.
authentication.s2Desc: We verify business dealers before approving their accounts, and they must guarantee the authenticity of the watches they list. Dealer approval and a seller's authenticity guarantee do not mean Kariv has physically authenticated every individual watch.
authentication.s3Desc: Private sellers must provide proof of ownership for Kariv to review before their watches are listed. All sellers must retain records supporting provenance and any inspection claims they make. Proof of ownership helps establish the right to sell a watch but does not, by itself, prove its authenticity; supporting records are not automatically included with a purchase.
authentication.s4Desc: Listings should identify the watch's brand, model, reference and condition, and disclose known service parts, aftermarket components or customisation. Each product page should make clear which box, papers or service records are included. Packaging and documents alone do not prove authenticity.
authentication.s5Desc: The “Verified” catalog status means submitted listing information and photographs were reviewed. It is not physical authentication, manufacturer approval or a certificate. For any watch described as independently inspected or certified, ask who performed the work, when, what was checked and for the supporting report.
authentication.noFakesTitle: Questions or concerns about a watch
authentication.noFakesDesc: If a listing or delivered watch raises a concern, contact Kariv support with the listing or order reference and supporting photographs or details. Keep a delivered watch and its packaging unchanged while the concern is assessed. We investigate with the responsible seller and apply the relevant return and legal-conformity rights; a listing status does not limit statutory rights.
authentication.independenceDesc: Kariv Glamour is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the watch brands displayed on this site, and is not their authorised dealer. Brand names, logos and model names belong to their respective owners and are used to identify the watches offered.
authentication.purchaseDesc: Our website uses HTTPS to protect information sent during checkout. The payment and protection terms available for an order are shown before payment. Escrow or additional buyer protection applies only when expressly offered and confirmed for that order; it is not included with every watch.

hero.title: Kariv Buyer Protection
hero.description: Kariv Glamour is an independent marketplace for watches offered by private owners, businesses and Kariv itself. Check the seller, payment terms and return rights for your order. We are not affiliated with watch manufacturers.

items.title: Payment Terms for Your Order
items.text: Standard checkout is the usual payment route. Escrow applies only when it is expressly offered and confirmed for your order.

items.title: Commitment to Authenticity
items.text: Sellers must offer genuine watches and disclose known replacement or aftermarket parts. Listing review is not physical authentication.

items.title: Returns and Statutory Rights
items.text: Eligible consumer purchases from a professional seller normally include a 14-day withdrawal right. Defect and authenticity claims follow separate legal rights.

items.title: Seller Information
items.text: Check whether the seller is Kariv, another business or a private owner. Dealer account approval does not authenticate an individual watch.

items.title: Insured Shipments
items.text: Orders must be shipped with insurance and tracking to help protect both domestic and international purchases.

items.title: Kariv Customer Support
items.text: Contact our support team about a listing, payment, delivery, return or authenticity concern.

steps.title: Choose Your Watch
steps.text: Review the seller and the watch’s reference, condition, photos, included accessories, service records, price and delivery terms before ordering.

steps.title: Review the Payment Instructions
steps.text: Use the payment method shown at checkout. A standard order does not automatically include escrow or delayed payment to the seller.

steps.title: Seller Ships the Watch
steps.text: The seller ships the watch using an insured shipping method with tracking. Shipment details are added to your order so you can follow the delivery.

steps.title: Inspect Your Watch
steps.text: After delivery, you have time to inspect the watch, compare it with the product listing, and confirm that the condition, documents, and accessories match the description.

steps.title: Follow Your Order Terms
steps.text: Payment follows the terms confirmed for your order. If escrow is expressly included, its inspection and release conditions apply.

steps.title: Support Is Available
steps.text: If something is wrong, Kariv Glamour support helps guide the next steps, including return, refund, or dispute review where applicable.

escrow.title: Standard Checkout and Optional Escrow
escrow.intro: Purchases normally use standard checkout. Escrow is a separate payment arrangement and applies only if it is expressly offered before payment and confirmed in your order. Do not assume that a standard bank transfer is held in escrow.
escrow.highlight: Only an order that expressly includes escrow has escrow payment-holding and release terms.
points: Check the seller and payment recipient before transferring funds.
Read any order-specific inspection period before payment.
Where escrow is included, follow its stated release and dispute conditions.

Payments arranged outside the platform do not receive Kariv escrow handling.
escrow.importantText: This page does not promise escrow for every order or a universal money-back guarantee. Your applicable statutory rights remain unaffected by the payment method.

authenticity.title: Commitment to Authenticity
authenticity.intro: Kariv is an independent marketplace and reseller, with no affiliation, endorsement or authorized-dealer relationship with watch manufacturers. We require private and business sellers to offer genuine watches, describe their condition accurately and disclose known replacement or aftermarket parts.
points: Original and replacement parts should be disclosed
Report suspected counterfeit or misleading listings to support
authenticity.notice: A “Verified” listing means its information was reviewed. It does not mean Kariv physically inspected the watch or that a manufacturer certified it. Ask for documentation supporting any item-specific authentication claim.
authenticity.counterfeitIntro: Listing review considers the information supplied for the offer. It is distinct from opening, examining or testing a watch. Physical inspection and service claims should name the provider and be supported by records for that watch.

moneyBack.title: Returns, Withdrawal and Product Concerns
moneyBack.intro: For eligible online consumer purchases from a professional seller, including Kariv when it is the seller, you normally have 14 days from delivery to withdraw without giving a reason. The statutory cooling-off right generally does not apply to a sale by a private individual. Rights concerning faulty, misdescribed or non-genuine goods are separate.
covered: Missing box or papers when included in the listing
notCovered: Change-of-mind returns from private sellers depend on any agreed return terms.
After the statutory withdrawal period, other remedies may still apply.
Handling beyond what is necessary to inspect the watch may reduce its value.
Keep the box, papers and accessories; missing outer packaging alone does not remove statutory withdrawal rights.
Tell support about any separate agreement with the seller.
Disclosed wear is part of the agreed condition; undisclosed faults may require a remedy.
Any statutory exception to withdrawal must actually apply to the purchase.
moneyBack.eligibilityNote: A 14-day withdrawal period or an escrow inspection period does not shorten applicable rights for defects, misdescription or authenticity issues. The Returns and Refunds policy explains the relevant process.

returnSteps.title: Contact Kariv Support
returnSteps.text: To withdraw, notify the seller within the applicable deadline; you do not need a reason. Kariv support can help. Report product concerns promptly with your order number and available details.

returnSteps.title: Return the Watch Safely
returnSteps.text: Confirm the return address and follow the applicable return deadline. Use secure packaging and return the included accessories and documents. Keep proof of dispatch; request suitable insured shipping instructions.

returnSteps.title: Receive Your Refund
returnSteps.text: The seller handles the refund under the applicable legal rules and return terms. Kariv support can assist with the order and any payment processed through the platform.

moneyBack.note: For a change-of-mind withdrawal, the buyer pays return postage only where the applicable rules and pre-purchase information provide for it. The professional seller bears the cost of returning defective goods.

dealers.title: Seller Standards and Account Approval
dealers.intro: Private owners and professional businesses may offer watches through Kariv, and Kariv also sells its own stock. Professional dealer accounts require administrator approval. This account approval is separate from a physical inspection of any watch and does not indicate manufacturer authorization.
requirements: Respect for Kariv Glamour return and buyer protection rules

items.a: This page explains Kariv’s seller and listing standards, customer support and the payment and return terms to check before buying. Protection depends on the seller, the order terms and applicable law; it is not a universal escrow or refund promise.

items.q: How does the Kariv Escrow Service work?
items.a: Standard checkout is the usual route. Escrow applies only when expressly offered and confirmed for the order. Its payment-holding, inspection, dispute and release conditions must be provided before payment.

items.q: How long do I have to inspect my watch?
items.a: Inspect the watch promptly. Eligible consumer purchases from professional sellers normally have a 14-day withdrawal period from delivery. Any escrow inspection period is stated separately and does not shorten applicable defect or authenticity rights.

items.q: Are all watches on Kariv Glamour authentic?
items.a: Sellers must offer genuine watches and disclose known modifications or replacement parts. A Verified listing means information review, not physical authentication or manufacturer certification. Request records supporting the specific watch.

items.q: What happens if the watch is not as described?
items.a: Contact the seller and Kariv support promptly with your order number and available evidence. The appropriate remedy depends on the issue and applicable law; defect claims are not automatically limited to 14 days.
Eligible sellers are required to ship watches with tracking and insurance. This helps protect buyers in rare cases of loss, theft, or unsuccessful delivery.

For a change-of-mind withdrawal, the buyer may bear return costs if properly informed before purchase. A professional seller is responsible for the cost of returning defective goods. See the Returns and Refunds policy.

items.q: What should I keep after receiving the watch?
items.a: Keep the original packaging, shipping materials, box, papers, warranty card, certificate, links, tags, service documents, and all accessories until you are certain you are keeping the watch.

No. Follow the payment terms confirmed for the order; escrow must be expressly included. An off-platform payment is outside Kariv’s payment handling, but the payment method does not remove applicable statutory rights.

items.q: Can I return a watch because I changed my mind?
items.a: Eligible online consumer purchases from a professional seller normally have a 14-day right of withdrawal without a reason, subject to statutory exceptions. Purchases from private individuals generally do not have that right unless agreed.

items.q: What happens if the package arrives damaged?
items.a: Document the damage immediately with photos and contact Kariv Glamour support. Keep all packaging and do not discard any shipping materials until the case is reviewed.

items.q: What if I suspect the watch is counterfeit?
items.a: Contact the seller and Kariv support promptly with the order number and any photos or records. Keep the watch and documents available for review. An escrow or return period does not shorten applicable legal remedies for an authenticity issue.
